description: This file defines the HomePageDao class, which provides data access methods for retrieving home page and module default page records based on user roles and priorities within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: HomePageDao
classes.description: Data access object for home page and module default page retrieval based on user roles and priorities.

methods.name: getHomePagesInPriorityOrder
methods.description: Retrieves home page records for specified user roles ordered by priority and ID descending.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrder
methods.description: Retrieves module default page records for specified module and user roles ordered by module name and priority descending.
